change_rationale: The v3 flat catalogue produced BY q=1 for all candidates and local-scale flooding. v3.1 makes the hierarchy explicit instead of pretending broad global detections and clean local refinements are exchangeable objects.

method_identity.global_backbone: the first 32 exposure-normalized recurrent-EOM parents, maximum 300 core members, in recurrent-stability order
method_identity.refinements: year-blind global and fixed overlapping 10-degree EOM/leaf candidates ranked by year-label calibration after cross-scale deduplication
method_identity.refinement_membership: leave-one-year-out robust halo with density FDR q<=0.10 followed by D<=0.15 orbital gate
method_identity.flat_order: 32 backbone candidates followed by calibrated refinements
method_identity.target_access: none during generation, ranking, expansion, or gating

fairness_disclosure: The 32-anchor backbone was introduced after inspecting the failed v3 fair benchmark. All v3.1 fair results are therefore development-set evidence and require untouched survey validation before a generalization claim.
stopping_rule: Any further semantic or parameter change creates v3.2 and restarts the gate order.
